flowchart TB
  ST1["IDENTIFICATION"]:::stage
  A["Records identified through the<br/>Web of Science Starter API<br/><b>n = 88</b><br/>88 current searches"]:::main
  B["Duplicate records removed<br/><b>n = 37</b>"]:::excluded

  ST2["SCREENING"]:::stage
  C["Records screened by title and abstract<br/><b>n = 51</b>"]:::main
  D["Records excluded<br/><b>n = 16</b><br/><br/>Publication type: 3<br/>Outside Eurasian scope: 1<br/>Non-human or no relevant human evidence: 4<br/>Outside period or assigned subtopic: 5<br/>Methods only: 1<br/>No direct relevance: 2"]:::excluded
  E["Reports sought for retrieval<br/><b>n = 35</b>"]:::main
  F["Reports not retrieved<br/><b>n = 2</b><br/>Full text unavailable: 2"]:::excluded
  G["Full-text reports assessed for eligibility<br/><b>n = 33</b>"]:::main
  H["Full-text report excluded<br/><b>n = 1</b><br/>No direct relevance: 1"]:::excluded

  ST3["INCLUDED"]:::stage
  I["Studies included in the migration<br/>and language synthesis<br/><b>n = 32</b><br/>Core evidence: 17 | Contextual evidence: 15"]:::included

  ST1 --> A --> B --> ST2 --> C
  C -->|Excluded| D
  C --> E
  E -->|Not retrieved| F
  E --> G
  G -->|Excluded| H
  G --> ST3 --> I

  classDef stage fill:#2f75b5,color:#ffffff,stroke:#2f75b5,stroke-width:1px,font-weight:bold;

  classDef excluded fill:#fff4e6,color:#7c2d12,stroke:#c2410c,stroke-width:1.5px;
  classDef included fill:#e2f0d9,color:#274e13,stroke:#548235,stroke-width:2px;
  linkStyle default stroke:#64748b,stroke-width:1.5px;
